top_choice_rationale: P001 (Mircea Cărtărescu, one writer, one prize part) is the only proposal naming a writer, and I rank it first on literary grounds, not because all six round-2 files prefer it. Public knowledge of Blinding and Solenoid points to a voice recognisable as his alone, and to formal achievement carried by the sentence and by large patterned structures in which memory, the body, dream and metaphysical speculation form one project. The poetry-to-prose arc supports a whole-oeuvre citation, worded as prose grounded in a poet's language because the poetic strand is the least visible part of the evidence in translation. Reservations remain: I judge Romanian sentence rhythm only through translations of uneven quality, I have not read the originals or independently verified any source, coverage of the poetry and early work is thin, and no one has shown whether later volumes extend or repeat earlier motifs. The committee also risks overvaluing an inward metaphysical project. None of these reservations has been substantiated, and none outweighs the case, so I prefer an award to P000.
